arms: incumbent: variant v3-opus, the settings of runs/dev-panel-noise-lab1 (Phase 1 replicate 1), whose graded results and first-round snapshots stand for it

each move: a variant of the incumbent run on the panel with --backend modal --memory past --parallel 8, reusing the incumbent's first round when the move does not change it; an accepted move is run a second time
primary_endpoint: Which moves the code accepts: paired against the incumbent on the 20 tasks, a move is accepted only if rescued - damaged >= T = 3 (M-15), damaged <= 1, cost per task <= 1.25 x the incumbent's, and a second run of the move has net > 0. The incumbent at the end is the candidate frozen for the held-out test.
stop_rules: Stop after 8 moves, 3 rejections in a row, or $400 spent across moves (per evaluation run at most $50). A halt by a usage or spending limit is resumed with the same command; nothing is re-planned.
notes: Phase 4 of the v4 plan. Proposer: an Opus agent that sees only the ledger summary and outcome counts by kind; an invalid or repeated move falls back to the fixed rule queues (top failure kind first: settled claims judged Not verifiable, so the first rule move is turning the re-check on). Dev tasks only: the loop never runs on held-out data. Graded by exact match on the label after every agent of an evaluation has exited.
